title: Bengbo
description:
🎲 Roll the Dice. Fire the Gun. Laugh at the Chaos.Welcome to Bengbo, a dice-driven FPS roguelike where every bullet is a gamble, every boss is ridiculous, and every run is as unpredictable as a casino slot pull.

What is Bengbo?Most roguelikes test your reflexes. Bengbo tests your luck, and your ability to laugh when that luck runs out. With full Swedish voice acting, casino-themed arenas, and weapons powered by dice of every shape and size, Bengbo delivers a uniquely chaotic blend of comedy and challenge.

🎲 Dice-Powered CombatChoose from d4s, d6s, d12s, and even the legendary d20, each die changes how your weapon behaves. Will your next roll save you, or send you into glorious failure?

🤖 Absurd Boss FightsFace casino-themed monstrosities who play by their own rules. Every encounter feels like a bizarre mix of stand-up comedy and bullet hell.

🏛️ Arena & Lounge SystemBattle through arenas, then cool off in the lounge where you gamble upgrades, unlock new dice, and prepare for your next doomed run.

🎤 Fully Voiced in SwedishEvery line is delivered with unapologetic Swedish charm. Subtitles included—so you won’t miss a single joke, even if you don’t speak the language.

🎨 Award-Winning Art StyleWinner of Best Art at the Swedish Game Awards and nominated for Best Narrative 2023.
description_short: A dice-powered FPS roguelike where every roll changes your shots. Battle bizarre bosses, upgrade, and gamble your way through nonstop chaotic action.
